author: Zintenka
body:
I've experimented around with this and this is HUGE!

I created a spawner that can spawn falling diamond blocks in mid air every minute... With this, I've efficiently created an infinite diamond supply.

I believe that this can work for Iron blocks as well, effectively creating a regenerative ore block supply. This can prevent team griefers from griefing the ore supply as it will essentially be infinite.

However, I need to tweak around with this to prevent the blocks from continuously spawning and crashing the server.

Here's some screenshots of an infinite supply of diamonds on my upcoming map: Ocalrythum.
Spawner

Diamond drops every minute (1200 ticks)

Infinite diamond supply!

Hope it works well with Nebula!

replies.body: I've been thinking, would it be possible to have regenerating monuments like this?
replies.body_tagged: I've been thinking, would it be possible to have regenerating monuments like this?

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
They could, but the thing is that if the block was already destroyed then Avi's plugin would already register it as destroyed.

The block will just be a block and not an objective :P
